part.text:
All 13 tests pass. The implementation in `src/main/java/Zipper.java`:

**`Zipper`** — a mutable node holding `value` plus `up`/`left`/`right` zipper links:
- `Zipper(int)` initializes the value; `up` starts `null` (root).
- `setLeft`/`setRight` attach a child zipper, point the child's `up` back at this node, then walk the `up` chain to keep every ancestor's child pointer consistent — so mutations at a deep focus are visible from the root.
- `setValue` changes the value and propagates the same way.
- `toTree` walks `up` to the root and wraps it in a `BinaryTree`.
- `equals`/`hashCode` compare the whole tree (`toTree().printTree()`), so two zippers focusing on the same node in the same tree are equal regardless of the path taken to reach them.

**`BinaryTree`** — a view over a root zipper:
- `BinaryTree(int)` builds a single-node tree; `BinaryTree(Zipper)` wraps an existing root; `getRoot()` returns it.
- `printTree()` renders `value: V, left: ..., right: ...`, with children as `{ ... }` blocks or `null`, matching the expected strings exactly.
- `equals`/`hashCode` are structural via the printed form, so `zipper.toTree()` equals the original `binaryTree`.

No test or build files were modified, and no new files were needed since both classes live in the solution file.
